findings.summary: Public API default for Context.lookup_default changed from call=True to call=False, and type overloads/documentation disagree with the implementation.
findings.evidence:
- The overloads still indicate the default for call is True (src/click/core.py:703-711), but the implementation changed the default to False (src/click/core.py:712) [ref:t5].
- This is a silent behavior change for external callers of lookup_default who rely on the previous default of invoking callables, and it also creates an inconsistency between type hints and runtime behavior [ref:t5].
- The failing tests indicate internal callers expected invocation by default, which further suggests the default should remain True unless all call sites are updated (and the overloads/docstrings adjusted) [ref:t10].
findings.suggested_fix:
Either:
- Revert the implementation signature to def lookup_default(self, name: str, call: bool = True) to match existing overloads and prior behavior, or
- If keeping call=False is intentional, update all call sites that require invocation (consume_value, and any others) to pass call=True explicitly, and update the overloads and documentation to reflect the new default.
Given backward compatibility concerns, reverting to call=True is the safer change.

findings.summary: Callable values in default_map are no longer invoked during runtime resolution.
findings.evidence:
- In Parameter.consume_value, the code calls ctx.lookup_default(self.name) without specifying call, which now uses the changed default call=False and returns the callable object instead of invoking it (src/click/core.py:2341-2344) [ref:t7].
- The implementation of lookup_default now defaults to call=False (src/click/core.py:712), so the above call no longer invokes callables (src/click/core.py:712-733) [ref:t5].
- Tests demonstrate the regression: the output shows the function repr rather than the invoked value (tests/test_defaults.py::test_lookup_default_callable_in_default_map and ::test_default_map_with_callable_flag_value, failures show "name='<function ...>'" and "<function <lambda> ...>" instead of "lazy-value"/"lazy-map") [ref:t10].
findings.suggested_fix:
In Parameter.consume_value, pass call=True explicitly when fetching from default_map:
  default_map_value = ctx.lookup_default(self.name, call=True)
This restores runtime invocation while keeping help rendering paths that use call=False intact.
